test_tf_doc_url: test the tf_doc_url function to resolve TensorFlow API symbols to their documentation URLs
test_tf_role_fn: test the tf_role_fn Sphinx role function that generates reference links for TensorFlow API symbols
test_link_to_top_level: test link_to_top_level resolves top-level TensorFlow symbols like function and Module to doc URLs
test_link_to_nested_package: test link_to_nested_package resolves nested package paths like autograph.to_code to doc URLs
test_link_to_method_of_exported_class: test link_to_method_of_exported_class resolves class method references like TensorArray.read to doc URLs
